course.title: Technical English
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Make sentences with the following structures using the words given in brackets.
(i) Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb of manner (pollute as verb)
(ii) Subj. + Modifier + Verb + that + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of place (is and·study as verb)
(iii) Subj. + Appositive + Linking verb + Adj. complement (seem as verb)
(iv) What + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of manner + Verb + Adj. complement. (demand and is as verb)
(v) Before + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of place, subj. + Verb + Adv. of place (came and were as verb)
(vi) Neither + Subj. + nor + Subj. + Verb + Object (obey as verb)
(vii) Subj. + relative pronoun + Verb + Object + Verb + Noun complement (demand and are as verb).

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
